research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: JetPack Aviation is focused on developing jet-powered aircraft, as evidenced by their work on a frame member integrated with at least one jet engine. This engine features a thrust discharge axis, a connector portion, and a discharge opening, all designed to optimize thrust along the engine's axis. The engine is securely mounted on the frame, indicating a focus on stability and efficiency in jet propulsion systems. This research highlights JetPack Aviation's commitment to advancing jetpack technology through innovative design and engineering.

overview_description.description: JetPack Aviation dedicated to building world's first true jetpack, that is capable of getting from SF to Mountain View in ten minutes. Its mission is to build a vehicle that that will disrupt the way people and "things" are transported.

product.name: JB10 JetPack
product.description: A personal VTOL jetpack powered by two turbojet engines, designed for piloted vertical takeoff and landing flights with speeds over 120 mph and endurance up to 8 minutes.

product.name: JB11 JetPack
product.description: A personal VTOL jetpack powered by six turbojet engines with engine management systems for thrust balancing and failure control, offering longer endurance than the JB10.
